events.title: JAWED DEMO UPDATE + DEMO SOUNDTRACK OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Thank you to everyone who has already played the JAWED DEMO. Every playthrough, every stream, every bug report and every comment means the world. This update is built directly on your feedback.THE JAWED DEMO SOUNDTRACK IS OUT NOWThe original score from the JAWED demo is now available on all major streaming platforms, including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and more.Link: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/reinerthegod/jawed-first-tape-official-game-soundtr

events.title: JAWED DEMO is OUT NOW!
events.summary: Your mouth is forced shut, but your eyes are wide open. Unlock the trauma of your past in the JAWED DEMO, now available on Steam.It’s time to take control of your life as Adam, a man suffering from PTSD in the wake of a complicated co-dependent relationship. With his apartment as his prison, Adam must find a way to unlock the truth of his past and, more importantly, the metal muzzle that has now caged his jaw!
